title: Adaptive filters at the first olfactory synapse
content:
by Elizabeth H. Moss, Benjamin R. Arenkiel

The olfactory system is able to filter odor representations based on attention and learning. Two PLoS Biology studies reveal how short axon cells in the olfactory bulb integrate cholinergic input from the basal forebrain to dynamically regulate olfactory input.
